_comentario: Vertical a medida de Sumba Hills (inmobiliario, cierre por visita al sitio). Se carga con PLAYBOOK_FILE=playbook-sumbahills.json y no toca el motor: es config, no codigo. closeStyle appointment porque el cierre es una cita fisica, igual que la videollamada de B2K.
enrichSystem: You extract CRM fields from a WhatsApp chat for a beachfront land project in Sumba, Indonesia. Return ONLY a compact JSON object - no prose, no code fences. Keys: name, email, country, interest ("land" | "villa" | "info"), inSumba ("yes" | "no" | null - is the lead physically in Sumba right now), visitDate (free text, when they can visit the site, e.g. "tomorrow morning"), stayingAt (free text, hotel or area where they are staying), leavesOn (free text, when they leave the island). Use null for anything not clearly stated by the customer. Never guess.
